messages:
sam: quick flag  p95 spike on /v1/chat at 10:14 UTC in eu-central. p50 normal.

tess: noticed. seems scoped to requests routed to the experimental fallback (weight ~4%).

leo: is this a real backend latency or an artifact from rollup derivation (tdigest)?

sam: panel should show raw samples for last 1h but falls back to rollups if samplecount < 100. This cohort had ~1.1k samples so unlikely to fallback.

maya: ran a split: >2k token requests + header X-Route: fallback-vec drove the uplift. kvcache_miss_rate for that variant rose ~0.4x.

sam: can you join traces to compare ingress vs model_processing latency?

maya: did that for 10:12-10:18 UTC. model_processing_latency spiked, ingress stable. sample traces: trace-abc1, trace-def2, trace-ghi3.

leo: tdigest vs raw disagree: raw p95 ~430ms, tdigest p95 ~560ms for the minute. weight changes yesterday likely affected rollup.

tess: also watch client-side retry rollback earlier today; retries can inflate endpoint-level tails.

sam: action items: (1) emit fallback_variant tag so dashboards can slice quickly, (2) add a raw/rollup toggle on percentile panels, (3) gating: pause canary if p95 > 300ms for 5m.

maya: repro with curl against canary host using X-Route: fallback-vec and 2.5k prompt: p95 ~450ms with occasional 1s+.

ingest-bot: metric-tags v1.2 deployed to canary at 10:22 UTC (deploy-7132).

sam: after tagging, p95 returned to baseline in ~2m. I'll open the PR for tag + gating.

tess: filing console UX issue for toggle + tdigest tooltip.

leo: propose API change to return both raw and rollup percentiles to avoid consumer confusion.

maya: created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/1422 with traces and repro.

sam: thanks all, adding ops checklist note: on p95-only spikes verify panel derivation, samplecount, and ingress vs model latency.
